svg.title: NET-10-E — Empty session browser
svg.desc: NET-10-empty. Successful zero-row read; no-selection reason blank, Join selected disabled, upper Refresh focused. The canvas origin is (25,20); SVG coordinates use the top-left origin. Production bottom-left: unchanged heading (28,490), 794 by 20; enlarged white list body (28,248), 794 by 242; read-only detail border (28,108), 794 by 128, with 8 px inner padding and 12 px separation below the list. No selected metadata or removed static captions appear. UX-NET-10-008 lowers Join selected, Direct connect and Back to (28,28), (296,28), (564,28), each 252 by 32 with 16 px gaps. Conditional paging moves down 40 px to y=68; it is hidden for this single-page state. Refresh remains (710,518), 112 by 24, with unchanged focus/status clearance under UX-NET-10-042. Forward/reverse traversal, hidden-input exclusion, discovery and joining behavior remain unchanged. Retain six headings and one complete noninteractive inline description; production colors follow UX-NET-10-037.

g.text: No active sessions listed. You can host a session or connect directly.
Retained six-column heading strip; empty white body with one full noninteractive status line.
Join selected disabled. Refresh focused. Direct connect remains independent.
No rows, body dividers, scrollbar, selection, hover, or focus. Colors: UX-NET-10-037.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; hide paging if neither direction exists.
